summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of the redemption and cancellation of listing of CNH2,750,000,000 3.40% Notes due 2027 (Series 43). HSBC, as issuer, will redeem all outstanding notes on June 29, 2026 at the principal amount of CNH1,000,000 per Calculation Amount plus accrued interest. The listing on the London Stock Exchange and the Taipei Exchange will be cancelled shortly after redemption. This is a routine debt redemption and delisting of notes, not a special situation.
